reason: Nine separately estimated member-power lower bounds must have simultaneous coverage before their complements are combined. Unadjusted 95% intervals do not provide a 95% family confidence guarantee.
rule: For each candidate and member, calculate the Wilson lower endpoint using one-sided alpha 0.05/9 (equivalently a two-sided confidence level of 1 - 2*0.05/9). Combine the nine simultaneous lower bounds as max(0, 1 - sum(1 - lower_member)).
failureRule: If no candidate passes the simultaneous dependence-robust bound and reserve gate, no confirmatory prefix may be selected. Do not revert to unadjusted member intervals or diagnostic joint power.
claimBoundary: This prospectively corrects simulation-confidence accounting. It is not a pilot, power result, selected N, resource authorization, scientific finding, independent review, or publication result.
